why_ai: Unlicensed screen-based selling protected mainly by buyer relationships, while order exchange, in-house desks and programmatic buying erode the commission.
why_clarity: Orders and rates are exact and requests recur daily, but pricing is done by feel and share outcomes arrive weeks later in pooled reports.
why_digital: Requests, ratings, proposals and orders are all data exchanged remotely, though selling still leans on calls and relationships with buyers.

why_ai: Station groups pay for the rep's buyer relationships and market read, but they can and do take national sales in-house or automate it.
why_clarity: Power ratio is a measurable outcome, but the pricing method behind it varies by seller and the share label lags by weeks.
why_digital: Avails, proposals and orders move between systems on screens, with negotiation by phone and email.

why_ai: Political demand is growing and carries compliance exposure, but the desk's paperwork and quoting are mechanisable.
why_clarity: Mixes a codified candidate regime with judgement-heavy issue pricing, and recurs only in even years.
why_digital: Orders, disclosure forms and quotes are digital documents, though political buyers deal through relationships.

why_ai: The lowest unit charge is a rule applied to rate history, which software can compute and document.
why_clarity: An exact, checkable deliverable defined by regulation, with rebate claims as fast feedback on errors.
why_digital: Rate histories, quotes and disclosure paperwork are entirely digital and handled remotely.

why_ai: Pricing scarce pre-election inventory against a few dozen buyers is adversarial and high-stakes, though forecasting will assist it.
why_clarity: Revenue per spot is measurable, but cycles come every two years and the method is the desk's judgement.
why_digital: Bookings, forecasts and rates are data on screens; deals close by phone with political buyers.

why_ai: Publishers pay for the rep's relationships with marketers in a vertical, which AI does not replace, though print's decline limits durability.
why_clarity: Revenue is measurable, but selling is relationship work done differently by every rep, with long, collection-lagged feedback.
why_digital: Media kits and orders are digital, but selling happens at trade shows and in meetings and print pages are physical.

why_ai: Packaging, clearance tracking and verification across small stations are mechanical and compete with digital audio's automated buying.
why_clarity: Clearance and delivery are checkable per spot, and network buys recur with a stable structure.
why_digital: Schedules, confirmations, affidavits and airplay monitoring are all data, and buys are placed remotely.

why_ai: Making the case for under-measured audiences depends on trust and advocacy with planners, and is novel market by market.
why_clarity: What counts as a credible audience case is contested, and evidence methods differ by rep.
why_digital: Audience evidence and proposals are digital; relationships with multicultural planners carry the sale.

why_ai: Answering avails and confirming orders for small stations is exactly the work agents can do without a seller.
why_clarity: Requests answered on time and orders won are countable, and the work repeats daily.
why_digital: Avails, proposals and orders are exchanged electronically or by email, all remote.

why_ai: Re-keying structured transactions between systems is directly substituted by integration and language-model extraction.
why_clarity: Each transaction maps between known schemas, and errors surface at confirmation or invoice.
why_digital: Entirely a data transfer between software systems.

why_ai: Posting and matching are rule-based and makegood selection is an optimisation problem software solves.
why_clarity: Delivery against a guarantee and three-way invoice matching are exact and checkable each flight.
why_digital: Ratings, logs, invoices and affidavits are digital and settled on screens.

why_ai: Stations trust a neutral custodian with confidential revenue, and the pooled census cannot be generated by AI.
why_clarity: The same monthly share reports per market, built from reported revenue and checkable against participants' books.
why_digital: Revenue submissions in, share reports out, all digital and remote.

why_ai: Value rests on contributed cost data competitors cannot assemble, though production of benchmarks is automatable.
why_clarity: Benchmarks follow a documented method each quarter and forecasts are checked by later clearing costs.
why_digital: Contributed buy data in, benchmark tables and forecasts out, delivered online.

why_ai: Advertisers pay for an independent auditor's credibility in disputes with agencies, which software alone does not supply.
why_clarity: Audit scope is defined and repeated per client, though findings are argued rather than proven.
why_digital: Invoices, buy records and benchmarks are analysed digitally and reported remotely.

why_ai: Ad recognition and coding are automatable, but the monitoring archive and its coverage keep their value.
why_clarity: Occurrence coding repeats at volume to a set taxonomy; spend estimates are only partly checkable.
why_digital: Captured ads in, coded data and reports out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Licensed attorneys advise and represent personally on political broadcasting rules, with liability attached.
why_clarity: The rules are codified, but edge cases and disputes require judgement and recur only in election years.
why_digital: Advice and filings are documents, with representation before the regulator and relationships with station clients.

why_ai: Campaigns hire buyers they trust on their side of the aisle, and targeting calls are high-stakes and time-bound.
why_clarity: Buys are measurable but each race is different and the outcome is an election result.
why_digital: Plans, orders and posts are digital; the work runs on partisan relationships.

why_ai: Enterprise software that AI-native entrants and language-model extraction can partly replicate, protected by integrations.
why_clarity: Software behaviour is specified and tested, with transaction errors visible quickly.
why_digital: Software sold and delivered remotely to stations and agencies.

why_ai: Clients buy a trusted adviser's experience, though generic sales training content is easily replicated.
why_clarity: Whether training or advice worked shows only slowly in revenue, and methods vary by firm.
why_digital: Assessments and analysis are digital, but training and strategy sessions are often delivered in person.

why_ai: Negotiating and posting buys at volume is increasingly automated by buying platforms and programmatic channels.
why_clarity: Buys, posts and benchmarks repeat by the thousand with measurable delivery.
why_digital: Avails, orders and posts are handled in buying systems, remotely.

why_ai: Posting, decks and pricing guidance are analytical work that software increasingly produces.
why_clarity: Posts are exact, but market cases and pricing guidance are argued rather than graded.
why_digital: Ratings, orders and revenue data in, presentations and guidance out, all digital.

why_ai: Group sellers carry agency relationships and pricing judgement, though the mechanics automate.
why_clarity: Revenue and share are measurable, while pricing policy rests on judgement.
why_digital: Orders and analysis are digital; selling to agencies runs on relationships.

why_ai: The market needs an accountable, neutral referee for measurement currency, which grows in importance as methods change.
why_clarity: Standards are documented and audits follow them, but accreditation decisions are infrequent and deliberative.
why_digital: Audit evidence and decisions are documents, with on-site audit work carried out by contracted firms.

why_ai: Member research and sales presentations are content that AI produces readily; convening and advocacy remain.
why_clarity: Advocacy research has no checkable success measure.
why_digital: Research is digital but delivered partly at conferences and member events.

why_ai: Pooled payment experience is data that credit platforms already score automatically.
why_clarity: Credit reports follow a fixed format and payment outcomes confirm them within months.
why_digital: Member-contributed payment data in, credit reports out, online.
